pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Tools for Xiaomi-ecosystem robot vacuums. Local control over the LAN via miIO (status, control actions, room-targeted cleaning by name) and map retrieval from the Xiaomi cloud (the map is a file in the account object store, not a device property). An MCP server exposes the local half to agents.
The command surface is split along a lifecycle boundary: the local and MCP paths never prompt, while the cloud login needs a captcha, an emailed code or a QR scan. That is enforced by dependency, so an always-on service cannot block on a human prompt.
